decision: Selected the Environment Agency public-register site location for permit EPR/BP3322LU (holder Pulsant Limited, 20 Westwood Avenue, Birmingham B11 3RZ) as the project locator for Pulsant's Birmingham WM-1 data centre. The register's own WGS84 latitude and longitude are copied without transformation.

selected_properties.register: Environmental Permitting Regulations – Installations for England

consistency_checks.pyproj: Transforming the register's easting and northing with pyproj 3.7.1 (EPSG:27700 to EPSG:4326) gives 52.4514451, -1.8531340, 1.1 m from the register's published latitude and longitude.
consistency_checks.postcode_centroid: The register's easting and northing (410078, 283731) equal the ONS centroid of postcode B11 3RZ (postcodes.io: 410078, 283731), so the register point was evidently derived from the site postcode.
consistency_checks.operator_address: Pulsant's Birmingham WM-1 datasheet gives the facility address as Westwood Avenue, Tyseley, Birmingham B11 3RZ, matching the permit's site address and holder.
consistency_checks.imagery: Esri World Imagery z17 tiles (x 64859-64863, y 43025-43028) viewed locally and not redistributed: the point falls on the roof of a large rectangular building almost fully covered by photovoltaic panels, on the south-west side of the main road, with a fenced service yard and parking; the datasheet notes on-site solar panels generating more than 400,000 kWh a year.

uncertainty: The register publishes no positional accuracy and its point coincides with the postcode centroid; the imagery check places it on the PV-roofed building, but the building outline itself is not taken from an official source.
